params.q: What is the fine for riding without a helmet in India?

search_parameters.q: What is the fine for riding without a helmet in India?

response.markdown:
The central fine is **₹1,000** under Section 194D of the Motor Vehicles (Amendment) Act 2019, which can also carry **disqualification/suspension of your driving licence for up to 3 months**. [0] [1] [2] [3] [4] [5] This applies to both the rider and the pillion passenger (above 4 years), and the helmet must be ISI/BIS-certified.

However, **states can set their own compounding amounts**, so the actual challan varies:

| State | Fine |
|---|---|
| Delhi, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Punjab, Andhra Pradesh, West Bengal, UP, Tamil Nadu, Rajasthan, Kerala, Gujarat (repeat) | ₹1,000 (some with 3-month licence suspension) |
| Telangana | ₹200 |
| Madhya Pradesh | ₹100 (1st), ₹300 (subsequent) |
| Himachal Pradesh | ₹1,500 |
| Goa | ₹500 (1st), ₹1,500 (subsequent) |
| Gujarat | ₹500 (1st), then DL suspension |

Repeat offences generally attract a doubled fine and possible disqualification from driving. [1]
